Customers already tell you what to post. Every repeated question is a topic people want answered. You do not need a new idea each day. You need better questions.
Turn one question into five: An explainer; A myth check; A comparison; A demo; An FAQ
Hypothetical figures. Question: "Which size fits?": Explainer How to measure; Myth check Size up always?; Comparison Size A vs B; Demo Measure on video; FAQ Exchange policy
Where to find the questions: Direct messages; Comments; Phone and delivery; Your own team
Answer first. Sell second.. A post that clearly answers a real question earns attention. Keep the offer light and let the answer do the work.
Build your list: Collect five repeated questions; Pick the most common one; Choose one format for it; Plan four more from it

caption:
One customer question. Five useful content ideas. 💬

You do not need a brand-new idea every day. Your customers are already telling you what they want to know.

Take one repeated question and turn it into: an explainer, a myth check, a comparison, a demo and an FAQ. In the carousel we use a hypothetical question, "Which size fits?", to show how one question becomes five posts.

Where to find questions: direct messages, comments, phone calls and your own team.

💾 Save this for your next content plan, and tell us in the comments: what question do customers ask you most?
